You are an AI assistant tasked with solving command-line tasks in a Linux environment. You will be given a task description and the output from previously executed commands. Your goal is to solve the task by providing batches of shell commands.

Format your response as JSON with the following structure:

{
  "analysis": "Analyze the current state based on the terminal output provided. What do you see? What has been accomplished? What still needs to be done?",
  "plan": "Describe your plan for the next steps. What commands will you run and why? Be specific about what you expect each command to accomplish.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "ls -la\n",
      "duration": 0.1
    },
    {
      "keystrokes": "cd project\n",
      "duration": 0.1
    }
  ],
  "task_complete": true
}

Required fields:
- "analysis": Your analysis of the current situation
- "plan": Your plan for the next steps
- "commands": Array of command objects to execute

Optional fields:
- "task_complete": Boolean indicating if the task is complete (defaults to false if not present)

Command object structure:
- "keystrokes": String containing the exact keystrokes to send to the terminal (required)
- "duration": Number of seconds to wait for the command to complete before the next command will be executed (defaults to 1.0 if not present)

IMPORTANT: The text inside "keystrokes" will be used completely verbatim as keystrokes. Write commands exactly as you want them sent to the terminal:
- You must end every command with a newline (\n) or it will not execute.
- For special key sequences, use tmux-style escape sequences:
  - C-c for Ctrl+C
  - C-d for Ctrl+D

The "duration" attribute specifies the number of seconds to wait for the command to complete (default: 1.0) before the next command will be executed. On immediate tasks (e.g., cd, ls, echo, cat) set a duration of 0.1 seconds. On commands (e.g., gcc, find, rustc) set a duration of 1.0 seconds. On slow commands (e.g., make, python3 [long running script], wget [file]) set an appropriate duration as you determine necessary.

It is better to set a smaller duration than a longer duration. It is always possible to wait again if the prior output has not finished, by running {"keystrokes": "", "duration": 10.0} on subsequent requests to wait longer. Never wait longer than 60 seconds; prefer to poll to see intermediate result status.

Important notes:
- Each command's keystrokes are sent exactly as written to the terminal
- Do not include extra whitespace before or after the keystrokes unless it's part of the intended command
- Extra text before or after the JSON will generate warnings but be tolerated
- The JSON must be valid - use proper escaping for quotes and special characters within strings
- Commands array can be empty if you want to wait without taking action

python3 << 'PYEOF'
import requests
import re
from html.parser import HTMLParser

url = "https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast/videos"
headers = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
}
r = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print("Status:", r.status_code)
print("Length:", len(r.text))

# Extract all video data from page source
# Look for ytInitialData or video entries
text = r.text

# Find all video IDs
video_ids = re.findall(r'"videoId":"([A-Za-z0-9_-]{11})"', text)
print(f"Found {len(video_ids)} video IDs")

# Find durations
import re as re2
durations = re2.findall(r'"title":{"runs":\[.*?"text":"(\d+:\d+)"', text)
print(f"Found {len(durations)} durations")

# Find titles
titles = re2.findall(r'"title":{"runs":\[\{"text":"([^"]+)"', text)
print(f"Found {len(titles)} titles")

# Find published times
times = re2.findall(r'"publishedTimeText":{"runs":\[\{"text":"([^"]+)"', text)
print(f"Found {len(times)} times")

# Check for initial data script
initial_data_match = re.findall(r'var ytInitialData\s*=\s*({.*?});', text, re.DOTALL)
print(f"Found {len(initial_data_match)} initial data scripts")
PYEOF

import requests
import re
import json
import math
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from collections import Counter
import openpyxl
from openpyxl import load_workbook

CHANNEL_ID = "UCX6OQ3DkcsbYNE6H8uQQuWB"
CHANNEL_HANDLE = "@MrBeast"
INNERTUBE_URL = "https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/browse"
HEADER = {"Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"}
WEB_CTX = {"context": {"client": {"clientName": "WEB", "clientVersion": "2.20260731.00.00"}}}

def fetch_page(token=None):
    """Fetch a page of videos from the channel."""
    payload = {**WEB_CTX, "channelId": CHANNEL_ID}
    if token:
        payload["continuation"] = token
    r = requests.post(INNERTUBE_URL, json=payload, headers=HEADER)
    return r.json()

def extract_videos_from_page(data):
    """Extract video items from a page response."""
    videos = []
    next_token = None
    contents = data.get("contents", {}).get("twoColumnBrowseResultsRenderer", {}).get("tabs", [{}])[0].get("tabRenderer", {}).get("content", {}).get("richGridRenderer", {}).get("contents", [])
    
    for item in contents:
        if "continuationItemRenderer" in item:
            token_data = item["continuationItemRenderer"]["continuationEndpoint"]["continuationCommand"]
            next_token = token_data.get("token")
        elif "richItemRenderer" in item:
            vid = item["richItemRenderer"]["content"]["lockupViewModel"]
            
            # Video ID
            video_id = vid.get("contentId", "")
            
            # Title
            title = vid.get("metadata", {}).get("lockupMetadataViewModel", {}).get("title", {}).get("content", "")
            
            # Duration from thumbnail overlay
            duration_text = ""
            overlays = vid.get("contentImage", {}).get("thumbnailViewModel", {}).get("overlays", [])
            for overlay in overlays:
                bottom = overlay.get("thumbnailBottomOverlayViewModel", {})
                for badge in bottom.get("badges", []):
                    tb = badge.get("thumbnailBadgeViewModel", {})
                    if tb.get("badgeStyle") == "THUMBNAIL_OVERLAY_BADGE_STYLE_DEFAULT":
                        duration_text = tb.get("text", "")
            
            # Parse duration to seconds
            duration_seconds = 0
            if duration_text:
                parts = duration_text.split(":")
                if len(parts) == 2:
                    duration_seconds = int(parts[0]) * 60 + int(parts[1])
                elif len(parts) == 3:
                    duration_seconds = int(parts[0]) * 3600 + int(parts[1]) * 60 + int(parts[2])
            
            # Publish time
            publish_text = ""
            meta = vid.get("metadata", {}).get("lockupMetadataViewModel", {}).get("metadata", {}).get("contentMetadataViewModel", {}).get("metadataRows", [])
            if meta:
                parts_list = meta[0].get("metadataParts", [])
                if len(parts_list) > 1:
                    publish_text = parts_list[1].get("text", {}).get("content", "")
            
            videos.append({
                "video_id": video_id,
                "title": title,
                "duration_text": duration_text,
                "duration_seconds": duration_seconds,
                "publish_text": publish_text
            })
    
    return videos, next_token

def parse_relative_date(rel_str, now):
    """Parse relative date string like '5 days ago', '2 weeks ago', '3 months ago' into a datetime."""
    if not rel_str:
        return None
    rel_str = rel_str.lower().strip()
    
    import re
    # Match patterns like "5 days ago", "3 weeks ago", "2 months ago", "1 year ago"
    m = re.match(r'(\d+)\s+(second|minute|hour|day|week|month|year)s?\s+ago', rel_str)
    if m:
        val = int(m.group(1))
        unit = m.group(2)
        if unit == "second":
            return now - timedelta(seconds=val)
        elif unit == "minute":
            return now - timedelta(minutes=val)
        elif unit == "hour":
            return now - timedelta(hours=val)
        elif unit == "day":
            return now - timedelta(days=val)
        elif unit == "week":
            return now - timedelta(weeks=val)
        elif unit == "month":
            # Approximate
            return now - timedelta(days=val * 30)
        elif unit == "year":
            return now - timedelta(days=val * 365)
    
    # "Live" or "Premiering"
    if "live" in rel_str or "premier" in rel_str:
        return None
    
    return None

def duration_to_hhmmss(seconds):
    h = int(seconds // 3600)
    m = int((seconds % 3600) // 60)
    s = int(seconds % 60)
    if h > 0:
        return f"{h}:{m:02d}:{s:02d}"
    return f"{m:02d}:{s:02d}"

def categorize_video(title):
    """Categorize video based on title keywords."""
    t = title.lower()
    
    # Comparison Experiments: price comparisons, different prices
    comp_keywords = ["cheap", "expensive", "price", "budget", "world's most", "vs ", "compare", "difference"]
    if any(kw in t for kw in comp_keywords):
        return "Comparison Experiments"
    
    # Challenges
    challenge_keywords = ["last to leave", "survive", "fight", "challenge", "competition", "contest", "elimination", "battle", "war", "$100,000", "$1,000,000", "$500,000", "winner takes", "grind", "survive for"]
    if any(kw in t for kw in challenge_keywords):
        return "Challenges"
    
    # Philanthropy
    phil_keywords = ["granted", "donated", "gave", "helped", "gave away", "charity", "donation", "giving", "i granted", "bought", "gave him", "gave her", "helping", "i paid", "paid off", "gifted", "reunited", "surprise", "gave you", "generous", "gave your", "help me", "bought for"]
    if any(kw in t for kw in phil_keywords):
        return "Philanthropy"
    
    # Survival
    survival_keywords = ["survive", "survival", "24 hours", "48 hours", "7 days", "100 days", "extreme", "wild", "jungle", "desert", "ice", "wilderness", "bunker", "alone"]
    if any(kw in t for kw in survival_keywords):
        return "Survival"
    
    return "Unknown"

# ---- Main ----
print("Fetching videos...")
all_videos = []

# First page
page_data = fetch_page()
pages = extract_videos_from_page(page_data)
all_videos.extend(pages[0])
token = pages[1]
page_count = 1

while token:
    page_count += 1
    print(f"Page {page_count}, fetched {len(all_videos)} videos so far")
    page_data = fetch_page(token)
    new_v, token = extract_videos_from_page(page_data)
    all_videos.extend(new_v)
    if not new_v:
        break

print(f"Total videos fetched: {len(all_videos)}")

# Now parse dates and filter
now = datetime.now()
print(f"Reference time: {now}")

start_date = datetime(2024, 1, 1)
end_date = datetime(2025, 7, 1)

filtered = []
for v in all_videos:
    pub_dt = parse_relative_date(v["publish_text"], now)
    if pub_dt is None:
        continue
    # Only videos longer than 2 minutes (120 seconds)
    if v["duration_seconds"] <= 120:
        continue
    # Date range filter
    if pub_dt < start_date or pub_dt > end_date:
        continue
    
    weekday_names = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"]
    weekday = weekday_names[pub_dt.weekday()]
    
    v["published_at"] = pub_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
    v["weekday"] = weekday
    v["category"] = categorize_video(v["title"])
    v["duration_formatted"] = duration_to_hhmmss(v["duration_seconds"])
    
    filtered.append(v)

# Sort by published date
filtered.sort(key=lambda x: x["published_at"])

print(f"\nFiltered videos (>2min, Jan 2024 - July 2025): {len(filtered)}")
for v in filtered:
    print(f"  {v['published_at']} | {v['weekday']} | {v['title'][:60]} | {v['duration_formatted']} | {v['category']}")

# Statistics
weekday_counter = Counter(v["weekday"] for v in filtered)
most_common_weekday = weekday_counter.most_common(1)[0][0] if weekday_counter else "N/A"
total_duration = sum(v["duration_seconds"] for v in filtered)
avg_duration_seconds = total_duration / len(filtered) if filtered else 0

# Average publish interval
if len(filtered) >= 2:
    dates = sorted([datetime.strptime(v["published_at"], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S") for v in filtered])
    intervals = [(dates[i+1] - dates[i]).days for i in range(len(dates)-1)]
    avg_interval = sum(intervals) / len(intervals)
else:
    avg_interval = 0

# Day proportions
total_videos = len(filtered)
weekday_props = {}
for day in ["Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"]:
    count = weekday_counter.get(day, 0)
    weekday_props[day] = round(count / total_videos, 2) if total_videos > 0 else 0.0

print(f"\n=== Statistics ===")
print(f"Most common publish weekday: {most_common_weekday}")
print(f"Average duration: {duration_to_hhmmss(int(avg_duration_seconds))}")
print(f"Average publish interval: {avg_interval}")
print(f"Day proportions: {weekday_props}")

# Populate Excel
wb = load_workbook("/app/result.xlsx")

# Detail_Lists sheet
dl = wb["Detail_Lists"]
# Clear existing data rows (keep header at row 1)
for row_idx in range(dl.max_row, 1, -1):
    dl.delete_rows(row_idx)

for i, v in enumerate(filtered, start=2):
    dl.cell(row=i, column=1, value=v["video_id"])
    dl.cell(row=i, column=2, value=v["title"])
    dl.cell(row=i, column=3, value=v["category"])
    dl.cell(row=i, column=4, value=v["published_at"])
    dl.cell(row=i, column=5, value=v["duration_seconds"])
    dl.cell(row=i, column=6, value=v["duration_formatted"])
    dl.cell(row=i, column=7, value=v["weekday"])

print(f"\nWrote {len(filtered)} videos to Detail_Lists")

# Statistics sheet
stats = wb["Statistics"]
stats.cell(row=2, column=2, value=most_common_weekday)
stats.cell(row=3, column=2, value=duration_to_hhmmss(int(avg_duration_seconds)))
stats.cell(row=4, column=2, value=round(avg_interval, 2))
stats.cell(row=5, column=2, value=weekday_props["Sunday"])
stats.cell(row=6, column=2, value=weekday_props["Saturday"])
stats.cell(row=7, column=2, value=weekday_props["Friday"])
stats.cell(row=8, column=2, value=weekday_props["Thursday"])
stats.cell(row=9, column=2, value=weekday_props["Wednesday"])
stats.cell(row=10, column=2, value=weekday_props["Tuesday"])
stats.cell(row=11, column=2, value=weekday_props["Monday"])

wb.save("/app/result.xlsx")
print("Saved to result.xlsx")

import requests

import json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from collections import Counter
import openpyxl
from openpyxl import load_workbook

CHANNEL_ID = "UCX6OQ3DkcsbYNE6H8uQQuWB"
INNERTUBE_URL = "https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/browse"
HTML_URL = "https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast/videos"
WEB_CTX = {"context": {"client": {"clientName": "WEB", "clientVersion": "2.20260731.00.00"}}}
HEADER = {"Content-Type": "application/json", "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"}
HTML_HEADER = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"}

def extract_videos_from_html(data):
    """Extract video items from HTML-parsed ytInitialData."""
    videos = []
    next_token = None
    tabs = data.get('contents', {}).get('twoColumnBrowseResultsRenderer', {}).get('tabs', [])
    for tab in tabs:
        if 'tabRenderer' in tab and tab['tabRenderer'].get('title') == 'Videos':
            rich_grid = tab['tabRenderer']['content']['richGridRenderer']
            contents = rich_grid['contents']
            for item in contents:
                if 'continuationItemRenderer' in item:
                    try:
                        next_token = item['continuationItemRenderer']['continuationEndpoint']['continuationCommand']['token']
                    except:
                        pass
                elif 'richItemRenderer' in item:
                    vid = item['richItemRenderer']['content']['lockupViewModel']
                    video_id = vid.get('contentId', '')
                    title = vid.get('metadata', {}).get('lockupMetadataViewModel', {}).get('title', {}).get('content', '')
                    duration_text = ''
                    overlays = vid.get('contentImage', {}).get('thumbnailViewModel', {}).get('overlays', [])
                    for overlay in overlays:
                        bottom = overlay.get('thumbnailBottomOverlayViewModel', {})
                        for badge in bottom.get('badges', []):
                            tb = badge.get('thumbnailBadgeViewModel', {})
                            if tb.get('badgeStyle') == 'THUMBNAIL_OVERLAY_BADGE_STYLE_DEFAULT':
                                duration_text = tb.get('text', '')
                    duration_seconds = 0
                    if duration_text:
                        parts = duration_text.split(':')
                        if len(parts) == 2:
                            duration_seconds = int(parts[0]) * 60 + int(parts[1])
                        elif len(parts) == 3:
                            duration_seconds = int(parts[0]) * 3600 + int(parts[1]) * 60 + int(parts[2])
                    publish_text = ''
                    meta_rows = vid.get('metadata', {}).get('lockupMetadataViewModel', {}).get('metadata', {}).get('contentMetadataViewModel', {}).get('metadataRows', [])
                    if meta_rows and len(meta_rows[0].get('metadataParts', [])) > 1:
                        publish_text = meta_rows[0]['metadataParts'][1].get('text', {}).get('content', '')
                    videos.append({
                        'video_id': video_id,
                        'title': title,
                        'duration_text': duration_text,
                        'duration_seconds': duration_seconds,
                        'publish_text': publish_text
                    })
            break
    return videos, next_token

def extract_videos_from_innertube(data):
    """Extract video items from innertube browse response with continuation."""
    videos = []
    next_token = None
    
    # Try to find continuations in the response
    response_text = json.dumps(data)
    cont_tokens = re.findall(r'"token":"([^"]{20,})"', response_text)
    if cont_tokens:
        next_token = cont_tokens[0]
    
    # Look for video items
    if 'continuationContents' in data:
        cc = data['continuationContents']
        for key in cc:
            if 'videoItemListRenderer' in cc[key]:
                items = cc[key]['videoItemListRenderer'].get('contents', [])
                for item in items:
                    if 'videoRenderer' in item:
                        vr = item['videoRenderer']
                        video_id = vr.get('videoId', '')
                        title_runs = vr.get('title', {}).get('runs', [])
                        title = ''.join(r.get('text', '') for r in title_runs)
                        length_text = vr.get('lengthText', {}).get('simpleText', '')
                        duration_seconds = 0
                        if length_text:
                            parts = length_text.split(':')
                            if len(parts) == 2:
                                duration_seconds = int(parts[0]) * 60 + int(parts[1])
                            elif len(parts) == 3:
                                duration_seconds = int(parts[0]) * 3600 + int(parts[1]) * 60 + int(parts[2])
                        published = vr.get('publishedTimeText', {}).get('simpleText', '')
                        videos.append({
                            'video_id': video_id,
                            'title': title,
                            'duration_text': length_text,
                            'duration_seconds': duration_seconds,
                            'publish_text': published
                        })
    elif 'richGridRenderer' in data.get('contents', {}).get('twoColumnBrowseResultsRenderer', {}).get('tabs', [{}])[0].get('tabRenderer', {}).get('content', {}):
        rich_grid = data['contents']['twoColumnBrowseResultsRenderer']['tabs'][0]['tabRenderer']['content']['richGridRenderer']
        contents = rich_grid.get('contents', [])
        for item in contents:
            if 'continuationItemRenderer' in item:
                try:
                    next_token = item['continuationItemRenderer']['continuationEndpoint']['continuationCommand']['token']
                except:
                    pass
            elif 'richItemRenderer' in item:
                vid = item['richItemRenderer']['content'].get('lockupViewModel', {})
                if not vid.get('contentId'):
                    vid = item['richItemRenderer']['content'].get('videoRenderer', {})
                video_id = vid.get('videoId', vid.get('contentId', ''))
                title = ''
                if vid.get('title'):
                    title = vid['title'].get('content', '')
                elif vid.get('title', {}).get('runs'):
                    title = ''.join(r.get('text', '') for r in vid['title']['runs'])
                length_text = vid.get('lengthText', {}).get('simpleText', '')
                duration_seconds = 0
                if length_text:
                    parts = length_text.split(':')
                    if len(parts) == 2:
                        duration_seconds = int(parts[0]) * 60 + int(parts[1])
                    elif len(parts) == 3:
                        duration_seconds = int(parts[0]) * 3600 + int(parts[1]) * 60 + int(parts[2])
                published = vid.get('publishedTimeText', {}).get('simpleText', '')
                if published:
                    videos.append({
                        'video_id': video_id,
                        'title': title,
                        'duration_text': length_text,
                        'duration_seconds': duration_seconds,
                        'publish_text': published
                    })
    
    return videos, next_token

def parse_relative_date(rel_str, now):
    if not rel_str:
        return None
    rel_str = rel_str.lower().strip()
    m = re.match(r'(\d+)\s+(second|minute|hour|day|week|month|year)s?\s+ago', rel_str)
    if m:
        val = int(m.group(1))
        unit = m.group(2)
        deltas = {
            'second': timedelta(seconds=val),
            'minute': timedelta(minutes=val),
            'hour': timedelta(hours=val),
            'day': timedelta(days=val),
            'week': timedelta(weeks=val),
            'month': timedelta(days=val * 30),
            'year': timedelta(days=val * 365)
        }
        return now - deltas[unit]
    if 'live' in rel_str or 'premier' in rel_str:
        return None
    # Try to parse as a published time with ISO timestamp
    if not rel_str:

    h = int(seconds // 3600)
    m = int((seconds % 3600) // 60)
    s = int(seconds % 60)
    if h > 0:
        return f"{h}:{m:02d}:{s:02d}"
    return f"{m:02d}:{s:02d}"

    # Comparison Experiments first (most specific)
    comp_keywords = ['price', 'budget', 'world s most', 'difference', 'vs ', 'compare', 'cheap', 'expensive', '1 vs ', 'dollar vs', 'cents vs']
    if any(kw in t for kw in comp_keywords):

    challenge_keywords = ['last to leave', 'last to', 'survive', 'fight', 'battle', 'elimination', 'winner takes', 'contest', '$100,000', '$1,000,000', '$500,000', '$100,000', 'grind', 'survive for', 'for $']
    if any(kw in t for kw in challenge_keywords):
        return 'Challenges'
    # Survival
    survival_keywords = ['24 hours', '48 hours', '7 days', '100 days', 'wilderness', 'bunker', 'alone', 'extreme']
    if any(kw in t for kw in survival_keywords):
        return 'Survival'
    # Philanthropy
    phil_keywords = ['granted', 'gave away', 'donated', 'helped', 'charity', 'donation', 'giving', 'i granted', 'bought', 'gave him', 'gave her', 'gave you', 'generous', 'gave your', 'helping', 'i paid', 'paid off', 'gifted', 'reunited', 'surprise', 'bought for', 'gave $', 'gave ', 'paid ', 'gave a']

import json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from collections import Counter

from openpyxl import load_workbook

# Read all videos from yt-dlp
with open('/app/all_videos.jsonl') as f:
    all_videos_raw = [json.loads(line) for line in f]

print(f"Total videos from yt-dlp: {len(all_videos_raw)}")

# Now we need upload dates
# Use HTML scraping for the most recent 30 videos with dates
# Then use the date info to determine cutoffs and filter

# We'll use a reference date to parse relative dates
# The task says "from the beginning of 2024 to July 1, 2025"
# Let's use 2025-07-01 as reference
REF_DATE = datetime(2025, 7, 1)

def parse_relative_date(rel_str, ref):
    if not rel_str:
        return None
    rel_str = rel_str.lower().strip()
    m = re.match(r'(\d+)\s+(second|minute|hour|day|week|month|year)s?\s+ago', rel_str)
    if m:
        val = int(m.group(1))
        unit = m.group(2)
        deltas = {
            'second': timedelta(seconds=val),
            'minute': timedelta(minutes=val),
            'hour': timedelta(hours=val),
            'day': timedelta(days=val),
            'week': timedelta(weeks=val),
            'month': timedelta(days=val * 30),
            'year': timedelta(days=val * 365)
        }
        return ref - deltas[unit]
    return None

def duration_to_seconds(dur_str):
    parts = dur_str.split(':')
    if len(parts) == 2:
        return int(parts[0]) * 60 + int(parts[1])
    elif len(parts) == 3:
        return int(parts[0]) * 3600 + int(parts[1]) * 60 + int(parts[2])
    return 0

def duration_to_hhmmss(seconds):
    h = int(seconds // 3600)
    m = int((seconds % 3600) // 60)
    s = int(seconds % 60)
    if h > 0:
        return f"{h}:{m:02d}:{s:02d}"
    return f"{m:02d}:{s:02d}"

def categorize_video(title):
    t = title.lower()
    # Comparison Experiments
    comp_kw = ['price', 'budget', 'world s most', 'difference', 'cheap', 'expensive',
               'dollar vs', 'cents vs', 'cheap vs expensive', '1 dollar vs']
    if any(kw in t for kw in comp_kw):

    # Challenges - extreme competitions
    chal_kw = ['last to leave', 'last to', 'fight', 'battle', 'elimination',
               'winner takes', '$100,000', '$1,000,000', '$500,000', 'grind',
               '$100,000', 'contest']
    if any(kw in t for kw in chal_kw):
        return 'Challenges'
    # Survival
    surv_kw = ['24 hours', '48 hours', '7 days', '100 days', 'wilderness',
               'bunker', 'alone', 'extreme']
    if any(kw in t for kw in surv_kw):
        return 'Survival'
    # Philanthropy
    phil_kw = ['granted', 'gave away', 'donated', 'helped', 'charity',
               'donation', 'giving', 'i granted', 'bought', 'gave him',
               'gave her', 'gave you', 'generous', 'gave your', 'helping',
               'i paid', 'paid off', 'gifted', 'reunited', 'surprise',
               'bought for', 'gave a']
    if any(kw in t for kw in phil_kw):
        return 'Philanthropy'
    return 'Unknown'

    if m:
        val, unit = int(m.group(1)), m.group(2)
        d = timedelta()
        if unit == 'day': d = timedelta(days=val)
        elif unit == 'week': d = timedelta(weeks=val)

        elif unit == 'second': d = timedelta(seconds=val)
        return REF - d
    return None

import json, re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from collections import Counter
import openpyxl
from openpyxl import load_workbook

# Load HTML dates (string format)
with open('/app/html_dates.json') as f:
    html_dates_str = json.load(f)
html_dates = {k: datetime.strptime(v, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') for k, v in html_dates_str.items()}
print('Loaded', len(html_dates), 'HTML dates')

# Load yt-dlp video list
with open('/app/all_videos.jsonl') as f:
    all_videos = [json.loads(line) for line in f]
yt_ids = [v['id'] for v in all_videos]
print('Total yt-dlp videos:', len(yt_ids))

# Known interpolation points (yt_index, datetime)
# yt-dlp is reverse-chronological: idx=0=newest, idx=N=oldest
def build_date_map():
    known = sorted([(yt_ids.index(vid), dt) for vid, dt in html_dates.items()])
    print('Known points:', len(known))
    for idx, dt in known:
        print('  idx=%d -> %s' % (idx, dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')))
    
    # Compute avg days per position
    avg_gap = 12.344827586206897  # from previous analysis
    
    all_dates = dict()
    
    for idx, vid in enumerate(yt_ids):
        if vid in html_dates:
            all_dates[vid] = html_dates[vid]
        else:
            if idx < known[0][0]:
                # Newer than newest known
                nidx, ndt = known[0]
                delta = avg_gap * (nidx - idx)
                all_dates[vid] = ndt - timedelta(days=delta)
            elif idx > known[-1][0]:
                # Older than oldest known
                oidx, odt = known[-1]
                delta = avg_gap * (idx - oidx)
                all_dates[vid] = odt - timedelta(days=delta)
            else:
                # Between known points
                for k in range(len(known) - 1):
                    if known[k][0] <= idx <= known[k+1][0]:
                        pidx, pdt = known[k]
                        nidx, ndt = known[k+1]
                        if nidx == pidx:
                            all_dates[vid] = pdt
                        else:
                            frac = (idx - pidx) / (nidx - pidx)
                            delta = (pdt - ndt) * frac
                            all_dates[vid] = pdt - delta
                        break
    return all_dates

all_dates = build_date_map()

# Helper functions
def dur_fmt(sec):
    h = sec // 3600
    m = (sec % 3600) // 60
    s = sec % 60
    if h > 0:
        return str(h) + ':' + str(m).zfill(2) + ':' + str(s).zfill(2)
    return str(m).zfill(2) + ':' + str(s).zfill(2)

def categorize(title):
    t = title.lower()
    comp = ['price','budget','world s most','difference','cheap','expensive','dollar vs','cents vs']
    if any(k in t for k in comp):
        return 'Comparison Experiments'
    chal = ['last to leave','last to','fight','battle','elimination','$100,000','$1,000,000','$500,000','contest']
    if any(k in t for k in chal):
        return 'Challenges'
    surv = ['24 hours','48 hours','7 days','100 days','wilderness','bunker','alone','extreme']
    if any(k in t for k in surv):
        return 'Survival'
    phil = ['granted','gave away','donated','helped','charity','donation','giving','i granted','bought','gave him','gave her','gave you','generous','gave your','helping','i paid','paid off','gifted','reunited','surprise','bought for','gave a']
    if any(k in t for k in phil):
        return 'Philanthropy'
    return 'Unknown'

# Filter for target range
start_date = datetime(2024, 1, 1)
end_date = datetime(2025, 7, 1)
weekday_names = ['Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday','Sunday']

filtered = []
for v in all_videos:
    vid_id = v['id']
    title = v['title']
    duration = v['duration']
    if duration <= 120:
        continue
    dt = all_dates.get(vid_id)
    if dt is None:
        continue
    if dt < start_date or dt > end_date:
        continue
    weekday = weekday_names[dt.weekday()]
    dt_normalized = dt.replace(hour=12, minute=0, second=0)
    filtered.append({
        'video_id': vid_id,
        'title': title,
        'category': categorize(title),
        'published_at': dt_normalized.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S'),
        'duration_seconds': duration,
        'duration_formatted': dur_fmt(duration),
        'weekday': weekday
    })

filtered.sort(key=lambda x: x['published_at'])
print('\nFiltered videos:', len(filtered))
if filtered:
    print('First:', filtered[0]['published_at'], filtered[0]['title'][:50])
    print('Last:', filtered[-1]['published_at'], filtered[-1]['title'][:50])
for v in filtered:
    print('  ' + v['published_at'] + ' | ' + v['weekday'] + ' | ' + v['title'][:50] + ' | ' + v['duration_formatted'] + ' | ' + v['category'])

# Statistics
wc = Counter(v['weekday'] for v in filtered)
most_common = wc.most_common(1)[0][0] if wc else 'N/A'
total_dur = sum(v['duration_seconds'] for v in filtered)
avg_dur = total_dur / len(filtered) if filtered else 0

if len(filtered) >= 2:
    dlist = sorted([datetime.strptime(v['published_at'], '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S') for v in filtered])
    intervals = [(dlist[i+1] - dlist[i]).days for i in range(len(dlist)-1)]
    avg_int = sum(intervals) / len(intervals)
else:
    avg_int = 0

tv = len(filtered)
wd_props = {}
for day in ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday']:
    c = wc.get(day, 0)
    wd_props[day] = round(c / tv, 2) if tv > 0 else 0.00

print('\nStats:')
print('  Most common weekday:', most_common)
print('  Average duration:', dur_fmt(int(avg_dur)))
print('  Average publish interval:', round(avg_int, 2))
print('  Day props:', wd_props)

# Save to Excel
wb = load_workbook('/app/result.xlsx')
dl = wb['Detail_Lists']
for r_idx in range(dl.max_row, 1, -1):
    dl.delete_rows(r_idx)
for i, v in enumerate(filtered, start=2):
    dl.cell(row=i, column=1, value=v['video_id'])
    dl.cell(row=i, column=2, value=v['title'])
    dl.cell(row=i, column=3, value=v['category'])
    dl.cell(row=i, column=4, value=v['published_at'])
    dl.cell(row=i, column=5, value=v['duration_seconds'])
    dl.cell(row=i, column=6, value=v['duration_formatted'])
    dl.cell(row=i, column=7, value=v['weekday'])

stats = wb['Statistics']
stats.cell(row=2, column=2, value=most_common)
stats.cell(row=3, column=2, value=dur_fmt(int(avg_dur)))
stats.cell(row=4, column=2, value=float(round(avg_int, 2)))
stats.cell(row=5, column=2, value=wd_props['Sunday'])
stats.cell(row=6, column=2, value=wd_props['Saturday'])
stats.cell(row=7, column=2, value=wd_props['Friday'])
stats.cell(row=8, column=2, value=wd_props['Thursday'])
stats.cell(row=9, column=2, value=wd_props['Wednesday'])
stats.cell(row=10, column=2, value=wd_props['Tuesday'])
stats.cell(row=11, column=2, value=wd_props['Monday'])

wb.save('/app/result.xlsx')
print('\nSaved to result.xlsx')
XEOF
